text: A committee of 5 members is to be formed from 6 men and 4 women. In how many ways can this be done if the committee must have at least 2 women?
Two dice are thrown simultaneously. What is the probability that the sum of numbers on the two dice is a prime number?
A bag contains 4 red, 3 blue, and 2 green balls. Two balls are drawn at random. What is the probability that one is red and one is blue?
explanation: Total balls = 9. Total ways to pick 2 = C(9,2) = 36. Favorable (1 red, 1 blue) = C(4,1) x C(3,1) = 4 x 3 = 12. Probability = 12/36 = 1/3.

text: In how many ways can 10 identical chocolates be distributed among 4 children such that each child gets at least 1 chocolate?
explanation: Give 1 each to 4 children first. 6 chocolates left to distribute freely among 4 children (each can get 0 or more). Stars and bars: C(6+4-1, 4-1) = C(9,3) = 84.

text: Three cards are drawn from a standard 52-card deck. What is the probability that all three are face cards (J, Q, K)?
explanation: Total face cards = 12 (J, Q, K of each suit). P = C(12,3)/C(52,3) = 220/22100 = 11/1105.

text: In how many ways can 7 persons sit around a circular table such that two particular persons always sit together?
explanation: Treat 2 particular persons as 1 unit. Total units = 6. Circular arrangements = (6-1)! = 5! = 120. The 2 persons within the unit can swap = 2! = 2. Total = 120 x 2 = 240.

text: The probability that A solves a problem is 2/3 and B solves it is 3/4. If both try independently, what is the probability that the problem is solved?
From a group of 7 men and 6 women, 5 persons are to be selected. In how many ways can this be done if the group must have at least 3 men?
A speaks truth 4 out of 5 times. He tosses a coin and reports it is heads. What is the probability that it is actually heads?
explanation: Using Bayes' theorem: P(heads | says heads) = P(says heads | heads) x P(heads) / P(says heads) = (4/5 x 1/2) / [(4/5 x 1/2) + (1/5 x 1/2)] = (2/5) / (2/5 + 1/10) = (2/5) / (1/2) = 4/5.

text: How many 5-letter words (with or without meaning) can be formed from letters of the word 'TRIANGLE' such that each word begins with T and ends with E?
explanation: TRIANGLE has 8 distinct letters: T, R, I, A, N, G, L, E. Word format: T _ _ _ E. Middle 3 positions filled from remaining 6 letters (R, I, A, N, G, L). Ways = P(6,3) = 6 x 5 x 4 = 120.

text: From a pack of 52 cards, 2 cards are drawn. What is the probability that both are aces?
How many diagonals can be drawn in a polygon with 12 sides?
explanation: Number of diagonals = C(n,2) - n = C(12,2) - 12 = 66 - 12 = 54.

text: A box has 6 red and 4 black balls. Balls are drawn one by one without replacement. What is the probability that the 4th ball drawn is red?
explanation: By symmetry, the probability that any specific draw is red = total red / total balls = 6/10 = 3/5. This holds for any position draw without replacement.

text: In how many ways can 6 boys and 4 girls be arranged in a row such that no two girls sit adjacent to each other?
explanation: First arrange 6 boys: 6! = 720 ways. Gaps created = 7 (including ends). Choose 4 gaps for 4 girls: P(7,4) = 7 x 6 x 5 x 4 = 840. Total = 720 x 840 = 604800.

text: What is the probability of getting exactly 2 heads when a fair coin is tossed 5 times?
A student must answer 10 out of 13 questions in an exam, choosing at least 4 from the first 5 questions. How many ways can this be done?
explanation: Case 1: Exactly 4 from first 5 = C(5,4) x C(8,6) = 5 x 28 = 140. Case 2: Exactly 5 from first 5 = C(5,5) x C(8,5) = 1 x 56 = 56. Total = 140 + 56 = 196.

text: In how many ways can the letters of the word 'MISSISSIPPI' be arranged?
explanation: MISSISSIPPI: 11 letters. M=1, I=4, S=4, P=2. Arrangements = 11! / (1! x 4! x 4! x 2!) = 39916800 / 1152 = 34650.

text: If P(A) = 0.4, P(B) = 0.5, and P(A intersection B) = 0.2, find P(A|B).
explanation: P(A|B) = P(A intersection B) / P(B) = 0.2 / 0.5 = 0.4.

text: A die is rolled 3 times. What is the probability of getting a sum of exactly 10?
explanation: Total = 6^3 = 216. Count ordered triples (a,b,c) with a+b+c=10, each between 1-6. By enumeration: favorable outcomes = 27. P = 27/216 = 1/8.

text: How many 6-digit numbers can be formed using digits 1 to 6 exactly once, such that the digits 1 and 2 are not adjacent?
explanation: Total arrangements of 1-6 = 6! = 720. Arrangements where 1 and 2 ARE adjacent: treat as block = 5! x 2! = 120 x 2 = 240. Not adjacent = 720 - 240 = 480.

text: A card is drawn from a well-shuffled deck. What is the probability that it is either a king or a red card?
In how many ways can the word 'ARRANGE' be arranged such that the two R's do not come together?
explanation: ARRANGE: 7 letters, A=2, R=2, N=1, G=1, E=1. Total = 7!/(2! x 2!) = 5040/4 = 1260. R's together: treat RR as unit = 6 letters with A=2 = 6!/2! = 360. R's NOT together = 1260 - 360 = 900.

text: An urn contains 5 white and 3 black balls. Two balls are drawn successively without replacement. What is the probability that both are white?
Find the number of ways of arranging 8 people in a circle if two specific people must always be opposite each other.
explanation: Fix one of the 2 people in the circle. The other must sit in the one opposite seat (1 way). Remaining 6 people fill 6 spots = 6! = 720. The fixed pair can swap positions = 2. Total = 720 x 2 = 1440.

text: A problem is given to three students A, B, C. Their probabilities of solving it are 1/2, 1/3, 1/4 respectively. What is the probability that exactly 2 of them solve the problem?
How many numbers between 100 and 1000 have exactly one of their digits as 7?
explanation: 3-digit numbers with exactly one digit = 7. Case 1: 7 in hundreds place, others not 7: 9 x 9 = 81. Case 2: 7 in tens place, hundreds not 7: 8 x 9 = 72. Case 3: 7 in units place, others not 7: 8 x 9 = 72. Total = 81 + 72 + 72 = 225.

text: What is the probability that a leap year selected at random has 53 Sundays?
explanation: A leap year has 366 days = 52 complete weeks + 2 extra days. These 2 extra days can be: (Mon,Tue), (Tue,Wed), (Wed,Thu), (Thu,Fri), (Fri,Sat), (Sat,Sun), (Sun,Mon) - 7 equally likely pairs. 53rd Sunday occurs if extra days contain Sunday: (Sat,Sun) or (Sun,Mon) = 2 cases. P = 2/7.

text: The number of ways of selecting 3 numbers from 1 to 20 such that they are in arithmetic progression is:
explanation: For AP (a, a+d, a+2d) with 1 <= a and a+2d <= 20. For each d: count of valid a = 20-2d. d ranges from 1 to 9. Sum = (18+16+14+12+10+8+6+4+2) = 90.

text: In how many ways can 5 different rings be worn on 4 fingers (any number of rings per finger)?
explanation: Each of the 5 rings can go on any of the 4 fingers independently. Total = 4^5 = 1024.

text: If two dice are thrown, what is the probability that the number on first die is greater than the number on second die?
explanation: By symmetry, P(first > second) = P(second > first). P(equal) = 6/36 = 1/6. P(first > second) = (1 - 1/6)/2 = (5/6)/2 = 5/12.

text: Three unbiased coins are tossed. What is the probability of getting at most 2 heads given that at least 1 head appears?
explanation: P(at least 1 head) = 7/8. P(at most 2 heads AND at least 1 head) = P(exactly 1H or 2H) = C(3,1)/8 + C(3,2)/8 = 3/8 + 3/8 = 6/8 = 3/4. P(at most 2H | at least 1H) = (3/4)/(7/8) = (3/4) x (8/7) = 6/7.

text: A and B throw a pair of dice alternately. A wins if he throws 6 before B throws 7. A starts. What is the probability of A winning?
A box contains 3 red, 4 blue, and 5 green pens. 3 pens are drawn at random. What is the probability that all are of different colors?
Find the number of triangles that can be formed from the vertices of a regular hexagon.
explanation: Total ways to choose 3 vertices from 6 = C(6,3) = 20. In a regular hexagon, no 3 vertices are collinear. So total triangles = 20.

text: There are 4 white and 6 black balls. A ball is drawn and not replaced; then another is drawn. What is the probability that the first is white and the second is black?
How many 3-digit numbers have exactly 2 distinct digits?
explanation: Total 3-digit numbers = 900. All same digit (1 distinct) = 9 (111, 222, ..., 999). All different (3 distinct) = 9 x 9 x 8 = 648. Exactly 2 distinct = 900 - 9 - 648 = 243.

text: 6 boys and 6 girls sit in a row randomly. What is the probability that all girls sit together?
explanation: Treat 6 girls as 1 block. Total units = 7 (6 boys + 1 block). Arrange 7 units = 7!. Girls within block = 6!. Total arrangements = 12!. P = (7! x 6!) / 12! = 5040 x 720 / 479001600 = 1/132.

text: There are 10 points in a plane, no three of which are collinear. How many straight lines and triangles can be formed?
explanation: Lines: any 2 points determine a unique line. C(10,2) = 45. Triangles: any 3 non-collinear points form a triangle. C(10,3) = 120. Answer: Lines = 45, Triangles = 120.

text: How many 5-letter words can be formed using the letters of 'APPLE'?
explanation: APPLE has 5 letters where P repeats 2 times. Arrangements = 5!/2! = 120/2 = 60.

text: In how many ways can the letters of 'BANANA' be arranged?
explanation: BANANA has 6 letters: B=1, A=3, N=2. Arrangements = 6!/(3! x 2!) = 720/12 = 60.
